scheme_name: E-YUVA Scheme: BIRAC’s Innovation Fellows (for post graduates and above)
other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian student who has completed a Master's degree (post‑graduate) and apply within 3 years of graduation (females exempted from the time limit)
Applicant must be an Indian student who has completed a Ph.D. and apply within 2 years of graduation (females exempted from the time limit)
Fellows are required to work full‑time at an E‑Yuva Centre (EYC)
Students currently pursuing a Ph.D. are not eligible for the fellowship
Selected fellows cannot pursue a Ph.D. during the fellowship tenure
benefits_summary: Fellows receive a monthly fellowship of INR 30,000 (post‑graduate) or INR 50,000 (post‑doctoral) plus an annual research grant of INR 3 lakhs or INR 5 lakhs respectively, together with continuous mentoring support.
